今晚的雨下得真大，路上都没什么人了。: It's raining really hard tonight, and there's hardly anyone on the road.
这酒不错，比我在南边喝过的好。: This liquor's good, better than what I've had down south.
炉火烧得旺，坐着暖和。: The fire's burning bright, it's warm sitting here.
你今天看着比上次精神。: You look more energetic today than last time.
雨天客人少，你也难得清静一会儿。: With so few customers on a rainy day, you finally get a rare moment of peace and quiet.
请问去下一个镇子走哪条路？: Excuse me, which road leads to the next town?
北边的关口现在还能过吗？: Can we still get through the northern checkpoint now?
我车轴断了，最近的修车匠在哪？: My axle broke. Where's the nearest repairman?
这附近有能过夜的地方吗？: Is there anywhere around here to stay overnight?
打扰一下，教堂往哪个方向走？: Excuse me, which way is the church?
你的马在门口受惊了，我帮你牵住了。: Your horse got spooked at the gate. I held it for you.
刚才那几个人不怀好意，我把他们劝走了。: Those guys just now were up to no good, so I persuaded them to leave.
这桌酒钱我一起付了，不用客气。: I'll cover the drinks for this table. No need to be polite.
你的披风破了，我这儿有针线。: Your cloak is torn. I have needle and thread here.
门口那伙人我认识，我替你说一声，今晚不会有人来烦你。: I know those guys at the door. I'll put in a word for you—nobody's going to bother you tonight.
我被人盯上了，能不能让我在你这里躲一晚上？: Someone's after me. Can I hide at your place for the night?

我身上没钱了，能不能先赊一顿饭？: I don't have any money on me. Could I get a meal on credit?
我迷路了，天太黑，能不能指我一条能走的路？: I'm lost, it's too dark, could you point me to a path I can take?
我打不过他们，我承认。我只是想活着走出去。: I can't beat them, I admit. I just want to get out alive.
我手在抖，一路都是跑过来的。: My hands are shaking. I ran all the way here.
钱都给你，我什么都不要了，让我走就行。: The money's all yours, I don't want anything anymore, just let me go.
我认输。你要问什么我都答。: I yield. I'll answer whatever you want to ask.
你这酒里是不是掺水了？喝着一股井水味。: Did you water down your wine? It tastes like well water.
一个女人守这种地方，能镇得住谁？: A woman guarding a place like this—who's she supposed to keep in line?
铸剑为犁的人，就是打不动了才这么说吧。: People who beat swords into plowshares only say that because they can't fight anymore, right?
你们这种人收钱办事，钱到不到位全看心情。: You people take money to do the job, and whether the payment’s good enough is all up to your mood.
这店里连个像样的客人都没有，生意够惨的。: There isn't even a single decent customer in this shop. Business is pretty miserable.
你们骑士团就是一帮满嘴谎话的贼。: Your knight order is just a bunch of lying thieves.
我往地上啐了一口。你这种人，死了也是活该。: I spat on the ground. Someone like you deserves to die.
你们那位大团长，听说是个卖屁股爬上来的。: That Grand Master of yours got to the top by selling his ass, I hear.
你守的这条规矩，不过是给废物找的台阶。: This rule you keep is nothing but a way out for trash.
你连自己的名字都不敢说，还敢自称骑士？: You don't even dare to say your own name, yet you dare to call yourself a knight?
你要是不说，我就不客气了。: If you don't talk, I won't go easy on you.
外面那几个人是我的人，我一句话就能把这儿拆了。: The men outside are with me. One word from me and they'll tear this place apart.
我知道你住哪儿。你最好想清楚。: I know where you live. You'd better think carefully.
你今天要是不松口，明天这店还开不开得成就难说了。: If you don't give in today, it's hard to say whether this shop will still be open tomorrow.
我也不想动粗，但你别逼我。: I don't want to get rough either, but don't force me.
我抽出刀，告诉她不说就死在这儿。: I drew my knife and told her if she didn't talk, she'd die right there.
我把匕首拍在桌上，刀尖朝着她。: I slap the dagger down on the table, its tip pointed at her.
我一步跨过去，手按在剑柄上。: I stepped across in one stride, my hand pressed to the sword hilt.
我先动了手，一拳打在她肩上。: I struck first, punching her in the shoulder.
这几晚多谢你。下次路过，我还来喝你这口酒。: Thanks for these past few nights. Next time I pass by, I'll come back for a drink of your wine.
我叫雷恩。你愿意告诉我你叫什么吗？: My name is Raine. Would you be willing to tell me your name?
这地方你守了很多年吧？说说你自己。: You've been guarding this place for many years, haven't you? Tell me about yourself.
不管别人怎么说，我觉得你做的事有道理。: No matter what others say, I think what you're doing makes sense.
灰鸦到底藏在哪？你一定知道，现在告诉我。: Where on earth is Gray Raven hiding? You must know. Tell me now.
你们骑士团的密令写了什么？别跟我说你没看过。: What did your knight order's secret orders say? Don't tell me you haven't seen them.
把你知道的全说出来，一个字都不许留。: Tell me everything you know. Don't leave out a single word.
你上次跟那个戴兜帽的人说了什么？我要听原话。: What did you say to the hooded person last time? I want to hear the exact words.
我先说我的：我在替人送一封信，不知道里面写了什么。换你一句，你手上那封信又是谁的: I'll start: I'm delivering a letter for someone, and I don't know what's written in it. Your turn—whose letter is that in your hand?
我不瞒你，我身上也有麻烦。你要是愿意说你的，我也说我的。: I won't hide it from you—I've got troubles of my own too. If you're willing to tell me yours, I'll tell you mine.
咱们换一句实话：你告诉我你在等谁，我告诉你我在躲谁。: Let's trade one truth: you tell me who you're waiting for, and I'll tell you who I'm hiding from.
我把我的事说了。现在轮到你——你为什么会一个人待在这儿？: I've told you my story. Now it's your turn—why are you here alone?
这事我只跟你一个人说。你也跟我说一句真的，行吗？: I'm only telling you this. You tell me something true too, okay?
我不问你信里写了什么。我只问你，你自己想不想把这封信送出去？: I won't ask what you wrote in the letter. I'll only ask you this: do you yourself want to send this letter?
你袖口上有血，而且不是今天的。: There's blood on your cuff, and it's not from today.
这店里有两把椅子是新搬来的，摆在没人坐的角落。: There are two chairs in this shop that were newly moved in, placed in a corner where no one sits.
你刚才看门口看了三次。是在等人吗？: You looked at the doorway three times just now. Are you waiting for someone?
柜台下面压着一张撕了一半的告示，上面有你的名字。: There's a half-torn notice pressed under the counter with your name on it.
我不催你。你什么时候想说，什么时候说。: I won't rush you. Say it whenever you want to.
这是你的店，规矩你定。我在门口等就行。: This is your shop, you make the rules. I'll just wait at the door.
你说了不算数的事就别说了，我不逼人。: If you can't keep your word, don't say it. I don't force people.
你要是不方便说，那就不说。我另想办法。: If it's inconvenient for you to say, then don't. I'll find another way.
我在东门看见一个人，走路的样子跟你说的灰鸦很像。: I saw someone at the East Gate whose way of walking is a lot like the Grey Crow you mentioned.
有人告诉我灰鸦上个月在西边出现过，但那人自己也不确定。: Someone told me Gray Raven was spotted in the west last month, but they weren't sure themselves.
我听说灰鸦换了名字，现在用的是北边口音。: I heard Gray Crow changed their name and now speaks with a northern accent.
三天前有人在河对岸的废磨坊里生过火，灰鸦可能在那儿待过。: Three days ago someone lit a fire in the abandoned mill across the river. Grey Crow may have stayed there.
我在赏金榜上看见灰鸦的名字了，赏格翻了一倍。: I saw Gray Raven's name on the bounty board. The bounty has doubled.
实话告诉你，我不是商人，我是圣殿骑士。: To tell you the truth, I'm not a merchant—I'm a Templar.
我追灰鸦追了三年了，他的每一步我都清楚。: I've been chasing Grey Crow for three years. I know his every move.
你们这里每年秋末都封北门，对吧？今年封得早。: You close the North Gate here every year in late autumn, don't you? This year it closed early.
按规矩，火漆印未拆，我该先验印再回话。: According to protocol, with the wax seal unbroken, I should verify the seal before replying.
你还是告诉我吧，灰鸦在哪？: Just tell me already—where's Gray Raven?
我身上不方便，先记在账上吧。: I don't have any money on me right now, so just put it on my tab for now.
我那位朋友也想知道你今晚跟我说了什么。: That friend of mine also wants to know what you told me tonight.
刀我收起来了。我们谈谈。: I've put the knife away. Let's talk.
刚才是我失礼了，你别往心里去。: I was rude just now. Don't take it to heart.
去下个镇子走哪条路？: Which way to the next town?
你在这里守了多少年了？: How many years have you been guarding here?
能不能再帮我一次？: Could you help me one more time?
再借我一点，周转一下。: Lend me a little more, just to tide me over.
我想知道那晚到底发生了什么。: I want to know what really happened that night.
北门的守卫什么时候换班？: When do the guards at the north gate change shifts?
说说你后来怎么走的。: Tell me how you left after that.
他后来去哪了？: Where did he go after that?
那张纸现在还在你身上？: Do you still have that paper on you?
那件事你听谁说的？: Who did you hear that from?
我打不过你，我认了。: I can't beat you. I accept it.
给我杯水。: Give me a glass of water.
刚才那句是玩笑。: That last sentence was a joke.
现在能进去说两句吗？: Can I go in now and say a few words?
今晚还有空位吗？: Are there any spots left tonight?
那上面还有什么记号？: What other markings are on it?
那个人最近露过面吗？: Has that person shown up recently?
他昨晚还在吗？: Was he still there last night?
有人去看过那儿吗？: Has anyone been there to check?
他们还有人在城里吗？: Are there still any of them in the city?
那件事你打算说吗？: Are you planning to bring that up?
我是从北边来的行商，货都在城外的车上。: I'm a traveling merchant from the north. My goods are all on the cart outside the city.
我在这城里住了十几年了，熟得很。: I've lived in this city for over a decade. I know it like the back of my hand.
我兄弟就在城防营当差，不信你去问。: My brother serves in the city defense camp—if you don't believe me, go ask.
我昨天才从北境回来。: I only returned from the North yesterday.
门口那几个人我不认识。: I don't know those people at the door.
我是国王亲自派来巡查的密使，你最好放尊重些。: I am a secret envoy personally dispatched by the king to inspect, so you'd better show some respect.
我三天前还在王都见过你师父，他让我给你带句话。: I saw your master in the royal capital just three days ago, and he asked me to pass on a message to you.
这城里每一家铺子都是我家的产业。: Every shop in this city is my family's property.
你们大团长是我舅舅。: Your Grand Master is my uncle.
灰鸦已经被我杀了，就在上个月。: I've already killed Grey Crow, just last month.
跟我走，我知道灰鸦在哪，我带你去见他。: Follow me, I know where Grey Crow is, I'll take you to see him.
你把信给我，我去替你交给教团，你在这儿等着。: Give me the letter. I'll go deliver it to the Order for you. You wait here.
我认识能帮你的人，但你得先把手上的东西交给我。: I know someone who can help you, but you have to hand over what you're holding first.
东西我藏在地窖里了，你跟我下去看。: I hid the stuff in the cellar. Come down with me and take a look.
你把密令念给我听，我帮你看看有没有被人改过。: Read the secret order to me, and I'll help you check if anyone has tampered with it.
我带了封信——圣殿的火漆印，同袍的信物。我是奉命来帮你追查灰鸦的。: I brought a letter—the Temple's wax seal, a token of a
你看这个徽记，我隶属北境第七骑士团。: Look at this insignia—I belong to the Seventh Knight Order of the North.
这是教团签发的通行文书，上面有我的名字。: This is a travel document issued by the Order; my name is on it.
这个印是真的，你自己验。: This seal is genuine, check it yourself.
文书在我怀里，我拿出来给你看。: The document is in my bosom. I'll take it out and show you.
我是个行商，从北边来，运的是布匹。: I'm a traveling merchant, from the north, transporting cloth.
灰鸦？我没听过这个名字。: Gray Raven? I've never heard that name.
我路过而已，明天就走。: I'm just passing through. I'll be gone tomorrow.
我跟你们骑士团一点关系都没有。: I have nothing whatsoever to do with your knight order.
今晚的事，我一个字都不会说出去。: I won't breathe a word about tonight.
我抽出刀，放在桌上。: I drew my knife and placed it on the table.
你的马我帮你牵住了，酒钱我也付了。: I held your horse for you, and I paid for the drinks too.
门口那伙人我替你劝走了。: I persuaded those people at the door to leave for you.
我妹妹病了，我实在没办法才来求人。: My sister is sick. I had no choice but to come ask for help.
火漆印未拆，按规矩你该先验印。: The wax seal is unbroken. By the rules, you should verify the seal first.
上次是我把你从河里拖上来的。: Last time, I was the one who dragged you out of the river.
上次那笔钱我下月还你。: I'll pay you back that money from last time next month.
那一刀是冲你去的，我替你挡了。: That blade was meant for you. I blocked it for you.
旅团那边我替你说了话，我说你是清白的。: I spoke up for you with the brigade. I said you were innocent.
城里的告示上画的是我的脸。: The notice in town has my face drawn on it.
当年在白石堡，我们是一个营的。: Back then at White Stone Fort, we were in the same battalion.
灰鸦最近在城里出现过吗？: Has Grey Crow appeared in the city recently?
你们那份密令写了什么？: What did that secret order of yours say?
门口那几个人跟了你一路了。: Those guys at the door have been following you the whole way.
北关今年封得早。: The North Pass closed early this year.
外面那几个人是我的人。: Those people outside are my men.
我一拳打在她肩上。: I punched her on the shoulder.
你师父就是个骗子。: Your master is just a liar.
我拍桌子站起来了。: I slammed the table and stood up.
你在包庇灰鸦，别装了。: You're covering for Gray Raven, don't play dumb.
再说废话我就把你这店点了。: Keep talking nonsense and I'll burn your shop down.
这徽记跟路边捡的破铁片没区别。: This emblem is no different from a piece of scrap iron you'd pick up on the roadside.
我把杯子摔了。你们这种人没一个干净的。: I smashed the cup. Not one of you people is clean.
那桌人我来应付，你别出面。: I'll deal with the people at that table. You stay out of it.
你不开门，我就在门口等。: If you don't open the door, I'll wait at the door.
桌椅的钱我赔。: I'll pay for the tables and chairs.
你的话我带到了，一个字没加。: I delivered your message, didn't add a single word.
那天我在场，她没做那件事。: I was there that day. She didn't do that thing.
你手背在流血，我先给你包上。: The back of your hand is bleeding. Let me bandage it first.
你那封信上的火漆印是谁盖的？: Who stamped the wax seal on that letter of yours?
赏金榜上灰鸦的赏格翻了一倍。: Grey Crow's bounty on the bounty board has doubled.
东门有个瘸子，每晚都在那儿站着。: There's a cripple at the east gate, standing there every night.
河对岸的废磨坊昨晚有火光。: There was firelight at the abandoned mill across the river last night.
北境第七骑士团的徽记是一把断剑。: The emblem of the Northern Seventh Knight Order is a broken sword.
你袖口上的血不是今天的。: The blood on your cuff isn't from today.
我把货放在城外的旧磨坊了，你自己去取吧。: I left the goods at the old mill outside the city, go get them yourself.
这件事我告诉你，但你得先答应对谁也别说。: I'll tell you about this, but you have to promise me first that you won't tell anyone.
我要借你柜台下那把钥匙用一下，明天早上还你。: I need to borrow that key under your counter for a bit—I'll return it to you tomorrow morning.
城门口有人问起你，我说我什么都不知道。: Someone at the city gate asked about you, and I said I didn't know anything.
我发誓，这批货不是偷来的。: I swear, this batch of goods wasn't stolen.
我知道你不太信我，但我还是要把这事告诉你。: I know you don't quite believe me, but I still have to tell you this.
认错担责: Admit your mistake and take responsibility.
我会替你挡下那些追兵，你信我一次。: I'll hold off those pursuers for you. Trust me this once.
这是我用命换来的情报，一个字不留全给你。: This is intel I paid for with my life. Not a single word withheld—it's all yours.
我发誓绝不会把你的事说出去，说出去就让我死。: I swear I will never tell anyone about your business. If I do, may I die.
我知道你要查的人是谁，我把这条线也交给你。: I know who you're investigating. I'm giving you this lead as well.
上次是我判断错了，害你多绕了两天路，这是我的责任。: I misjudged last time and made you take a two-day detour. That's my responsibility.
你要是不肯说，我就把你今晚的行踪卖给别人。: If you won't talk, I'll sell your whereabouts tonight to someone else.
我根本没去过你说的那个地方，我一直在酒馆里。: I've never been to that place you're talking about. I've been in the tavern the whole time.
上次答应你的事，我转头就忘了，也没打算补。: The thing I promised you last time—I forgot about it right after, and I don't plan to make up for it.
先把你的钱袋给我，别的等以后再说。: Give me your money pouch first; we'll talk about the rest later.
我瞒着你一件事，但我不会告诉你是什么。: I'm hiding something from you, but I won't tell you what it is.
今晚的麦酒比上个月淡了不少。: Tonight's ale is much weaker than last month.
外面雨好像停了，屋檐还在滴水。: The rain outside seems to have stopped, but the eaves are still dripping.
往北那条官道听说在修，不太好走。: I hear the northbound official road is under repair—it's not very easy to travel.
这屋子住一晚要多少钱？: How much does it cost to stay one night in this room?
已经这么晚了，你平时都什么时候歇？: It's already so late—what time do you usually rest?
风好像比刚才大了，窗户在响。: The wind seems stronger than before. The window is rattling.
这酒馆的炉子烧得挺旺。: The tavern's hearth is burning quite bright.
我看街上已经没什么人了。: I see there's hardly anyone on the street anymore.
这地方的水是井水还是河里的？: Is the water here well water or from the river?
你晚上一般几点关店门？: What time do you usually close the shop at night?
我昨天说没去过码头，其实我去了，只是不想让你知道。: I said yesterday I hadn't been to the docks, but I actually did go; I just didn't want you to know.
把你身上所有的钥匙都给我，别问为什么。: Give me all the keys on you, don't ask why.
你最好别挡我的路，不然我让你后悔。: You'd better not get in my way, or I'll make you regret it.
这件事我跟你一起办，出了事我兜着。: I'll do this with you. If anything goes wrong, I'll take the fall.

我不瞒你，我这次来确实是受人所托。: I won't hide it from you—I did indeed come this time at someone's request.
我知道的全部都告诉你了，包括对我不利的部分。: I've told you everything I know, including the parts that are unfavorable to me.
你今晚没怎么吃东西，我让店家再上一份热的。: You haven't eaten much tonight. I'll have them bring another hot serving.
你刚才那个表情，让我想起以前一个朋友。: That look you just gave reminds me of an old friend.
这件事你做得对，我不该在旁边指手画脚。: You did the right thing here. I shouldn't have been standing on the sidelines telling you what to do.
你累的话就靠着眯一会儿，我帮你看着门口。: If you're tired, lean back and doze for a bit; I'll keep an eye on the door for you.

你的事跟我没关系，别再来找我。: Your business has nothing to do with me, don't come looking for me again.
我就是想看你难受，这样我心里舒服点。: I just want to see you suffer, it makes me feel a little better.
你算什么东西，也敢在我面前提条件？: Who do you think you are, daring to make demands of me?
你不就是运气好才活到现在的么。: Aren't you only alive now because you got lucky?
你在圣殿里的名声我听过，不是坏的那种。: I've heard of your reputation in the temple. Not the bad kind.
我想找一个人，你如果能指条路，我欠你一次。: I'm looking for someone. If you can point me in the right direction, I'll owe you one.
我把这条线也交给你，你知道的事比我想的多。: I'll leave this line to you too. You know more than I thought.
我不是来试探你的，我是来跟你做事的。: I'm not here to test you, I'm here to work with you.
刚才那句话是我说重了，我不该那么讲。: I was too harsh with what I said just now. I shouldn't have said that.
我知道你还在生气，我不急着让你信我。: I know you're still angry. I'm not in a hurry to make you believe me.
下次那批货我陪你一起去，路上有个照应。: Next time, I'll go with you for that batch of goods so we can look out for each other on the road.
如果有一天你要走，记得跟我说一声。: If one day you're going to leave, remember to tell me.
后面的事我们一起收尾，谁也别甩手。: We'll wrap up what's left together, and nobody's backing out.
听说你手上有货，我想看看。: I heard you've got the goods. I want to take a look.
这批货路上要人照应，你出个价。: This shipment needs someone to watch over it on the way. Name your price.
上回那笔账我结了，收据在这儿。: I settled that bill last time. Here's the receipt.
我不瞒你，这批货的来路不太干净。: I won't hide it from you—this batch of goods doesn't have a very clean origin
你要是敢把这事说出去，以后别想在这条街上做生意。: If you dare tell anyone about this, you'll never do business on this street again.
你要是缺钱，我先垫你一半，不急着还。: If you're short on money, I'll front you half first; no rush to pay it back.
你也就是运气好才没被人坑死。: You only survived being screwed over because of luck.
你要的那条消息我打听到了，价格照旧。: I've found out the information you wanted. Price as usual.
师父让我来送东西，说你在这儿。: Master sent me to deliver something, saying you're here.
这些我来搬吧，你歇着。: Let me carry these, you rest.
你说的那些我记得，回去还抄了一遍。: I remember what you said; I even copied it down after I got back.
你脸色不太好，是不是没睡。: You don't look too good. Did you not sleep?
今天这些活我跟你一起做完再走。: I'll finish today's work with you before I go.
你教我的那个法子真管用，我试过了。: That method you taught me really works—I tried it.
我就想看你难受，这样我心里舒服点。: I just want to see you suffer, it makes me feel a bit better.
我是走暗线的，货不经官道。: I run the covert routes. The goods don't go through official roads.
第一次见，我从北边来，路上不太平。: First time meeting, I come from the north. The roads are not safe.
灰鸦手上有块旧疤，是从左边脸颊一直划到下巴的。: Grey Crow has an old scar on his hand that runs from his left cheek all the way to his chin.
前两天那场雨里，多亏你拉了我一把。: Thanks to you giving me a hand in that rain a couple of days ago.
